# Load in jsonlite package
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(igraph)
#Assign Node Data and get a snapshot

#datausers_nominal <- stream_in(file("/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/genius-expertise/user_info.json"))
#head(datausers)
#data_annotate <- stream_in(file(("//Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/genius-expertise/annotation_info.json")))
#head(data_annotate)
#songinfo <-  stream_in(file(("/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/genius-expertise/song_info.json")))
#head(songinfo)
# save(datausers_nominal, data_annotate, songinfo, file = "/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/initialfiles.Rdata" )

# Load in Node data
load("/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/initialfiles.Rdata")

# Assign Edge Data
edges_nominal <- read.csv("/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/genius-expertise/follows.csv")
length(unique(edges_nominal$follower))
length(unique(edges_nominal$following))



#Make Dataset with only users in node dataset and who are also contained 
# in folower and following

valid_users <- intersect(
  unique(data_annotate$user[!is.na(data_annotate$user)]),
  intersect(
    intersect(unique(datausers_nominal$url_name),
              unique(edges_nominal$follower)),
    unique(edges_nominal$following)
  )
)
edges_reduced <- data.frame()
edges_reduced <- edges_nominal[edges_nominal$follower %in% valid_users &
                                 edges_nominal$following %in% valid_users,
                               c("follower", "following")]
#stopifnot(all(unlist(edges_reduced) %in% nodes_reduced$url_name))
dim(edges_reduced)

#Make sure we intersect the annotation dataset and nodes dataset because annotate dataset has song info 
valid_nodes <- datausers_nominal[datausers_nominal$url_name %in% valid_users, ]

valid_annotate <- data_annotate[data_annotate$user %in% valid_users, ]

# Merge nodes and annotate by user name
nodes_reduced <- merge(valid_nodes, valid_annotate, by.x = "url_name",
                       by.y = "user", all.x = TRUE)
dim(nodes_reduced)

#Delete duplicate rows 
nodes_reduced <-nodes_reduced[!duplicated(nodes_reduced$url_name),]

#Check class of each variable in the merged dataset
sapply(nodes_reduced, class)

## Split up with dataframe Stats variable 
nodes_reduced$annotations <- nodes_reduced$stats$Annotations
nodes_reduced$suggestions <- nodes_reduced$stats$Suggestions
nodes_reduced$transcriptions <- nodes_reduced$stats$Transcriptions
nodes_reduced$questions <- nodes_reduced$stats$Questions
nodes_reduced$answers <- nodes_reduced$stats$Answers
nodes_reduced$pyongs <- nodes_reduced$stats$Pyongs

nodes_reduced <- subset(nodes_reduced, select = -stats)

## Deal with list variables
class(nodes_reduced$roles)
class(nodes_reduced$contribution_stats)
class(nodes_reduced$edits_lst)

#Split all roles into Boolean variables
all_roles <- sort(unique(unlist(nodes_reduced$roles)))
for (r in all_roles) {
  col <- paste0("role_", make.names(r))
  nodes_reduced[[col]] <- vapply(nodes_reduced$roles, function(x) r %in% x, logical(1))
}
#Delete original roles
nodes_reduced <- subset(nodes_reduced, select = -roles)

#Check contribution_stats
head(nodes_reduced$contribution_stats)
length(!is.null((nodes_reduced$edits_list)))

#All contribution stats values are null in this subset, delete from dataframe

nodes_reduced <- subset(nodes_reduced, select = -contribution_stats)

#Check edits_lst
head(nodes_reduced$edits_lst)
unlist(nodes_reduced$edits_list)

#All edits_lst values are null in this subset, delete from dataframe
nodes_reduced <- subset(nodes_reduced, select = -edits_lst)

#New colnames 
colnames(nodes_reduced)
dim(nodes_reduced)
g <- graph_from_data_frame(vertices = nodes_reduced, d= edges_reduced, directed = TRUE)
plot(g)
